description_en: Associates a Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance with a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 云连接网绑定云企业网
kebab_example: aliyun smartag attach-ccn-instance-to-cen --ccn-id ccn-isdjvvkexkrpk00000 --cen-id cen-joimmi1s2ob3rdxw79 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --subnet 172.16.55.0/24 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachCcnInstanceToCen

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance to attach
parameters.name: ccn_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance to authorize
parameters.help_zh: 指定要授权的云企业网实例的ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance. You can invoke the DescribeRegions operation to query the regions supported by Smart Access Gateway and the corresponding region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 云连接网实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions接口查询智能接入网关支持的地域以及对应的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The CIDR block used when the Cloud Connect Network (CCN) instance is attached to the CEN instance over the Internet
parameters.help_zh: 云连接网绑定云企业网使用的互联网段
parameters.name: subnet
